title: Concept: SOAP operation list in a response
description: A list of SOAP operations with their bindings in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The list names each operation and the binding it uses, which is a described contract an attacker can call directly without the client.
applicability: Deployments that render a list of SOAP operations with their bindings into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The list names each operation and the binding it uses, which is a described contract an attacker can call directly without the client.
